items.title: Bitcoin slides toward $71K as Nvidia stock tumbles after Huang steps down
items.content: Bitcoin fell to its lowest leve since Aug. 20 as tech stocks slid following the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang.

items.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO, exits board; shares plunge
items.content: Colette Kress will remain Nvidia’s chief financial officer while serving as interim CEO as the board searches for a permanent successor.

items.title: Bit Digital stock falls 5% in pre-market after Q3 revenue miss
items.content: Bit Digital’s $27 million third-quarter revenue came in 16% below analyst consensus estimates, marking an over $5 million shortfall.

items.title: Thailand proposes $148K daily cap on stablecoin deposits and withdrawals
items.content: Thailand’s SEC would set separate daily caps for stablecoin deposits and withdrawals and require customers to use wallets they own.

items.title: Crypto hack losses equal 57 cents per $1 earned onchain: Ark’s Valente
items.content: Crypto hackers stole $8.7 billion so far in 2026, surpassing the projected annual onchain revenue generated across the industry, according to ARK’s research director.

items.title: Are Alt-L1s over? Security, costs drive smaller chains to Ethereum
items.content: L1 blockchains Zilliqa, Gnosis and Ronin join the Ethereum ecosystem as the costs of going it alone grow, and the security and liquidity advantages become too hard to resist.

items.title: Uber’s UK banking partner Griffin raises $20M for stablecoin services
items.content: The Series B valued Griffin at more than $100 million and will help fund stablecoin reserve services and onchain cross-border payments.

items.title: EU DeFi proposals could push users to riskier platforms, says Coinbase exec
items.content: Coinbase’s EU policy chief says applying suitability tests beyond crypto lending and borrowing could limit access and fragment liquidity.

items.title: Stablecoin supply falls $14.2B in biggest 30-day drop since June 2022
items.content: Crypto markets were left with “less fuel” to rally after the market cap of major stablecoins saw its biggest 30-day drop in over four years.

items.title: Tron and Tether bring in Chainalysis after T3 crime unit folds
items.content: The group will focus on illicit USDT activity on Tron and help law enforcement investigate suspicious transfers and freeze funds faster.

items.title: Ethlabs drops Hegotá slot proposal in push for 2027 quantum readiness
items.content: Ethlabs’ roadmap aims to help Ethereum withstand quantum attacks and give users a way to protect their accounts by 2027.

items.title: BlackRock Bitcoin ETF outflows hit $2B over nine sessions
items.content: US spot Bitcoin ETF outflows rose to nearly $300 million on Wednesday, up from $95 million a day earlier, as five-session withdrawals reached $1.44 billion.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.content: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: South Korea to permit crypto withdrawal freezes during hacking threats
items.content: The move follows recent security incidents involving South Korean crypto exchanges, including GOPAX’s precautionary suspension of services and a $70,000 hot-wallet breach at Prabang.

items.title: Binance CSO unwittingly foreshadowed $6.3B hack tactic months before attack
items.content: In a July interview, Binance chief security officer Jimmy Su explained how fake coding assessments could compromise employee devices, a tactic later used in the exchange’s record-breaking hack.

items.title: MSCI confirms Strategy’s removal from indexes at end of November
items.content: Strategy, Metaplanet and Upexi are marked for deletion in MSCI’s final list, with changes taking effect after the Nov. 30 close.

items.title: Suiet wallet to shut down in latest exit from Sui ecosystem
items.content: The self-custodial wallet will keep its API services running through Nov. 14. Sui’s DeFi total value locked has fallen more than 22% over the past month.

items.title: Nvidia preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang after affairs: WSJ
items.content: The report about Huang’s possible departure came after the New York Times reported that he had a second extramarital affair.

items.title: Uncalled US House races could send more crypto allies to Congress
items.content: The remaining races feature pro-crypto candidates and others without a stated position, giving advocacy groups what they see as “an opportunity” for outreach.

items.title: Nomura explores sale of crypto unit Laser Digital: Bloomberg
items.content: The potential sale of Laser Digital follows a fourth straight quarterly loss for Nomura’s European operations.

items.title: US data center restrictions could give Bitcoin miners an edge in AI, though challenges remain
items.content: As US voters push back against new data centers, Bitcoin miners already expanding into AI could benefit from their existing facilities.

items.title: OKXICE moves ahead with tokenized stocks as blue chips push back
items.content: The Nov. 23 debut puts a new SEC exemption to the test as Nasdaq pursues its own tokenized stock plans after warning that trading across platforms could fragment liquidity.

items.title: Bitcoin hovers near $74K as stocks rise despite US bond yield rebound
items.content: Bitcoin traded in a narrow range as investors bought the dip in tech stocks and US bond yields climbed on high CPI inflation data.

items.title: Deutsche Bank launches crypto custody for companies and institutions
items.content: Clients can store and transfer Bitcoin, Ether and select stablecoins through the bank, which manages their wallets and private keys.

items.title: Paraguay bank collapse shows stablecoins can offer a lifeline... of sorts
items.content: Ueno’s collapse exposed the fragility of digital banking in Paraguay, as customers scrambled for access to their money and stablecoins offered a lifeline.

items.title: Bitcoin Covenants Part 5: MATT and OP_CHECKCONTRACTVERIFY — How Bitcoin could carry state across transactions
items.content: OP_CCV embeds contract state directly into Taproot output keys and enforces valid state transitions onchain. This makes it possible to achieve stateful contracts and compact fraud proofs.

items.title: CoreWeave stock jumps 15% premarket after Q3 revenue beats estimates
items.content: CoreWeave’s third-quarter revenue rose 168% to $3.66 billion, beating analyst estimates by 3.4%. Its revenue backlog reached $132.5 billion.

items.title: FSB urges Turkey to tighten crypto oversight, set stablecoin rules
items.content: The Financial Stability Board cited progress on crypto licensing and urged stronger enforcement and cooperation with foreign regulators.

items.title: Zcash falls below $1,000 for first time since September
items.content: Zcash fell nearly 15% amid a broader sell-off in privacy coins, a day after Grayscale pledged $1 million to ecosystem initiatives.

items.title: Barclays boosts BlackRock Bitcoin ETF stake 48% as banks expand holdings
items.content: Barclays reported a $187 million stake as of Sept. 30, while Citigroup disclosed a new $119 million position in Fidelity’s Bitcoin ETF.
